analysis_provenance.generic_source_reuse: Earlier generic extraction source adapted; no earlier result data imported

relocation.method: Canonical within-freeze-root paths mapped to local allowlisted relative evidence; raw bytes unchanged

clock_convention.development: Comparison completion Unix timestamp minus owner start Unix timestamp
clock_convention.usage: Notification observation Unix timestamp minus owner start Unix timestamp; includes shutdown receipts
clock_convention.host_clock: Host start Unix timestamp and original host-relative counters are retained separately; never treated as identical to owner start
clock_convention.checkpoint_costs: No interpolation; missing exact checkpoint usage/cost coordinates remain null

limitations: Single task; three campaigns share task, host and service; descriptive outcomes only.
Development checkpoints are adaptively selected; no campaign-wide confidence band.
One-sided nominal 90% portfolio lower bounds are the frozen uncertainty summary; raw family-pair plots show within-comparison block variation, not confidence intervals.
API-equivalent intervals cover observed token subtotals under hypothetical Standard rates, not actual billing or missing usage.
Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning; do not add subsets again.
Notification times are observation times; missing checkpoint usage has no invented coordinate.

curation.scope: Plot-ready derivative retaining unchanged rows consumed by plot.py, all extraction source hashes and original completion/limitations metadata. Arithmetic replay and full execution audit are separate.
curation.omitted_rows: Development family/raw-pair rows not consumed by plot.py. All 52 comparisons retained separately in raw-arithmetic.
curation.omitted_metadata: accounting_supplements retained in full locally extracted bundle and original analysis/checkpoints records.
